response.sql: WITH qualifying_patients AS (SELECT DISTINCT l.ID FROM Laboratory l INNER JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID WHERE l.`U-PRO` IS NOT NULL AND l.`U-PRO` != '-'), patient_level_averages AS (SELECT qp.ID, p.SEX, AVG(l.PT) as avg_pt, AVG(CASE WHEN l.ALP IS NOT NULL AND l.GPT IS NOT NULL THEN l.ALP / l.GPT END) as avg_alp_gpt_ratio FROM qualifying_patients qp INNER JOIN Patient p ON qp.ID = p.ID INNER JOIN Laboratory l ON qp.ID = l.ID GROUP BY qp.ID, p.SEX) SELECT SEX, AVG(avg_pt) as avg_pt, AVG(avg_alp_gpt_ratio) as avg_alp_gpt_ratio FROM patient_level_averages GROUP BY SEX
